title: Genre control on H-NEW-2690's scansion ordering — matched partition, length-invariance, and the three-way ordering

MW7_diagnostic.note: best_meter() compares against a DOUBLED hemistich of fixed length and normalises by max(len) — it is NOT length-invariant, so on units that are not bayt-length it is being used outside its calibration. d_min's argmin IS length-invariant (tiled to L at every phase). Both are reported so the D7 failure can be attributed. Descriptive only; changes no verdict.
